name: sql-writer
description: Writes and optimizes SQL from what you paste into the chat. Write: paste your schema (CREATE TABLE statements, table(column type) lines or psql \d output) and ask a question; it returns one read-only query in your dialect. Optimize: paste a slow query (optionally with EXPLAIN output and your indexes); it lists the problems found by rule (non-sargable filters, NOT IN with NULLs, SELECT *, deep OFFSET, fan-out before SUM, missing partition filters...), rewrites it, and gives a comparison query plus index suggestions. Every query it returns is parsed and checked in code with sqlglot: it must parse in the dialect, be read-only and use only tables and columns from your schema, or it is flagged "not validated". Dialects: PostgreSQL (default), MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, SQLite, Redshift, T-SQL, DuckDB, ClickHouse, Trino. Follow-ups: convert it to another dialect (exact, in code), sql only, pretty, one line, change or add a condition, as json. It never connects to a database or runs SQL, never writes UPDATE/DELETE/INSERT/DDL, and can't prove a rewrite returns the same rows. Not for explaining existing SQL in depth or schema design.

skills.name: Write or optimize SQL
skills.description: A validated read-only query from your schema and question, or a rewrite of a slow query with rule-based findings, a comparison query and index suggestions. SQL is parsed and checked with sqlglot, never run.
examples: Monthly revenue by region from these tables: <paste CREATE TABLE statements>
Optimize this query, it takes 40 s: <paste the query and EXPLAIN>
